cohort: The study included 17 COVID-19-positive pregnant patients admitted to the corona ward.
finding: Most pregnant women infected with COVID-19 exhibited mild symptoms, although severe outcomes like respiratory failure and maternal death were observed in some cases.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery for the cohort included 29.42% preterm, 58.83% normal-term, and 6.45% post-term deliveries.
